scene: The octopus taps back, sliding a damp brass key across.
picture: A flat side view along wet blue tile. Far left, a huge purple octopus presses against its tank glass. Left, a damp brass key sits on the floor. Centre, the player in her purple wheelchair pauses near a red pipe valve. Right, floating kelp fills a tall column. Far right, an open flooded archway awaits.
shown: A shiny brass key lying on the blue floor tile on the left
A red mechanical wheel valve fixed to a pipe in the centre
A dark tiled archway flooded with ankle-deep water at the far right
